'''2022 EGP Steve Brentson LS OA''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Brentson]] at [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]]
